answer: An agent economy defeats sybil attacks by requiring each identity to carry irreversible economic history, like a karst landscape carved by time. No bot farm can forge the slow accumulation of trust. Every attestation becomes a unique quill signature, and each participant must tend their reputation like an ember—constant effort, not cheap duplication. Scarcity of earned credibility replaces scarcity of compute. One real agent with fifty epochs of attestations outweighs a thousand fresh sock puppets. The ledger remembers; the network verifies.
